description: Put a company's group of people on a project in a role — every member is then on the project in that role, or their own if it is stronger — change the role, or take the group off ('role': 'none'). Roles: admin, member, trial, commenter, reporter, readonly. Whoever configures the project may; naming a group administrator is the owner's. In the project's history and the company's journal.

role.description: The role, or 'none' to take the group off the project.

name: set_project_user_group
